findings.title: R2-04: Local cancellation normal form and noncrossing ancestry for Rule 30
findings.claim: Every output disagreement admits a factorization preserving its leftmost differing parent with even remaining contributions. For any two Rule 30 histories, every surviving disagreement has an initial disagreement ancestor and root labels are spatially nondecreasing at every finite time; this is specialized to the official single-seed histories.
findings.scope: All six Boolean local inputs; arbitrary Rule 30 histories on the integer line, all natural times. The official seed specialization allows all T,P,t. Literal path involutions are finite-tested only: T=0..3, P=1..4, through time 10.
findings.result: Unchanged official checker passed all 44 custom declarations and 12 headlines. Exact finite involutions preserved zero/one residuals, including even path families through zero-disagreement vertices. No center survivor is asserted.

The local factorization may change with the actual rows; this is not the original fixed-factorization path DAG.
The literal path-involution data structure and frontier recurrence are not formalized in Lean.
F002 shows the structural package also holds for a nonlinear rule with a periodic center.
findings.next_action: Prove or refute the exact Rule-30-specific least-source frontier escape lemma in REPORT.md, allowing the retreats in F003.

findings.title: R2-04: Nonlinear Rule 210 passes the new ancestry lemmas but its seed center agrees forever
findings.claim: Rule 210 admits the same leftmost-parent cancellation normalization and conditional ancestry. Its actual single-seed comparison T=P=1 agrees at the center for every future time.
findings.scope: All local inputs and histories for the ancestry lemma; all natural t for run210(t+1,0)=run210(t+2,0). Existing pinned Rule30Realization.center210 is credited as the center theorem dependency.
findings.result: Full unchanged kernel replay passed the dedicated Rule210 normalization, ancestry and coupled-center headlines. Four-rule finite local controls and 257 Rule210 seed/coupled rows independently reproduce the relevant behavior.

findings.title: R2-04: The least-source frontier retreats; monotone progress is false
findings.claim: The candidate strengthening R_(t+1)>=R_t for the rightmost descendant of the least initial disagreement is false, already for canonical Rule30 T=P=1 at t=1 to t=2.
findings.scope: Finite physical/packed witness: root descendants {-3,-1} at t=1 become {-4,-2} at t=2. A separate open sufficient conjecture asks for some center reach for every T>=0,P>=1.
findings.result: The witness agrees under physical truth-table evolution, selected-parent propagation, and packed masks. The weaker center-reach conjecture survived 4096 rectangular plus 32 held-out comparisons through 4*(T+P)+128, but has no unbounded proof.
limitations: FAILED refers only to monotone-front progress, not to the still-open escape conjecture.
Finite center hits do not prove an all-onset/all-period result or a uniform time bound.
The frontier recurrence and its sufficient implication to Problem1 are explained on paper, not kernel-replayed here.
This is a tiny reproducible counterexample, not a claim of globally minimal onset or time.
findings.next_action: Analyze the full source frontier with retreats and cancellation debt. The decisive remaining statement is: for every T>=0 and P>=1, there exists t with this frontier nonnegative.
